notes.title: Release Version 1.0
notes.content:
Dear followers,

it is finally done! I achieved the unthinkable!
[h3] [b]Lose Ctrl is finished and available in stores around the world[/b].[/h3]

We had some struggles along the way, I needed to rewrite a lot from scratch and there many doubters. Even when I was awarded the Deutsche Computerspielpreis for Best Game Design, many people doubted me and said: Martin Jeremiah, you will NEVER release this game. 

But guess what: [b]they were wrong[/b]! They were SO WRONG! It is possible! You can release a game and be a successfull influencer/guru/entrepreneur at the same time. Don't let anybody tell you any different. 

I persevered, I powered through it. All the hard work, all the long nights, two burn-outs and one rehab - it all lead to this moment - and boy was it worth fighting for!

What you are about to play right now is one of the most daring, one of the most entertaining and one of the most deep works of interactive art of the last and the next 10 years. There is just nothing like it! 
[b]I DARE YOU TO FIND A GAME WHICH IS EVEN REMOTELY COMPARABLE TO THIS![/b]
And to humiliate my haters even more: not only did I just release one of the most groundbreaking games of the decade, I also wrote and release a book. My eductional book/autobiography THE MARTIN APPLE METHOD is available on Amazon right now. If want one of the limited hard copies, please reach out and I see what I can make possible.

So the game is done (and very good), the book is done (and also very good)... What is next for you Martin Jeremiah? What worlds are there more to conquer?

[b]It is true: with Lose Ctrl I let out a huge scream, which echoes will be heard in the game scene for decades to come.[/b] 
How can you even top that?
 What can you do after such a success?!

Do not worry about Martin Jeremiah, my dear friends. I will find something to put my mark on. I already had wildly successfull livestreams, so that might be an avenue worth exploring. I also like to do more of my NFT-art. So there is a lot of work. 
I must admit that like Alexander the Great I feel some emptiness even sadness right now. 

[i]"And Alexander wept, seeing as he had no more worlds to conquer."[/i]

So allow me - after years of working endlessly and tirelessly -[b] to take a step and find new worlds to conquer.[/b]

Forever yours,
Martin Jeremiah Apple
Proud founder and CEO of Play From Your Heart UG (haftungsbeschränkt)
Author of the Martin Apple Method

notes.title: Personal Update
notes.content:
Dear followers,

it has been a while since the last update. Does that mean, I am not working on the game anymore?

[b]HELL NO![/b]

As a matter of fact I am working harder than ever. Pulling all nighters and giving it my all every day!
But Martin Jeremiah, why are there no updates, you might ask? Fear not, my friend, there will be a [b]HUGE UPDATE[/b] very soon.

When everybody else left I decided to take the project in a more personal direction, giving it even more of that [b]delicious and award-winning Martin-Jeremiah-Apple-flavour.[/b] Alas, this takes time - a lot of time! A story as interesting and dramatic as mine is not easily put into a game. It is nearly impossible, but I intend to do it anyway.

As you all know my I am also working on my new book, which is also very demanding but fullfilling. Expect news for both the game and the book soon.

Wish you all a happy gaming,
Martin Jeremiah Apple

notes.title: Rollback of last update
notes.content:
Dear people,

in the last few days I have received a lot of reports about crashes and bugs in regards to our game.

[b]Effective immediately we well be rolling back our last update!
Everything will run as smooth as before!
We integrated the old code-base again, which is inferior, but more reliable![/b]

I will investigate what caused the crashes and bugs, and find the people at fault.
This will not happen again.

Wish you all a happy gaming,
Martin Jeremiah Apple

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE
notes.content:
Dearest gamers,

this update might not seem like much, but I assure you it is a huge update for me personally.

[b]I BASICALLY REWROTE ALL THE CODE![/b]

The game will now run smoother, look better, consume less power, have lower latency in multiplayer and will be over all a far superior experience.

On the surface there won't be any changes, be it in terms of content or UI, but under the hood everything is new and improved and ready for the future. This update will ensure, that the game has a bright future ahead of itself and that future content updates will be easy to integrate.

Personal note: this is a huge success for me as a programmer/person. After our coding team left, people told me to abandon the project. But I learned to code, and not only that: I also cleaned up and improved the existing code. So I have to confess I feel a lot of personal relief and satisfaction now that this update is released.

Have fun playing,
Martin Jeremiah Apple

notes.title: Update 0.9.5 - June 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,

it has been a while since the last update, but I can assure you that I, [u]Martin Jeremiah Apple[/u], am working hard and tirelessly to ensure the quality and vision of this game.
I am happy to annouce the following features for this new update:

[list]
[*]I integrated[b] STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]! Can you get them all?
[*]I reworked the ending, it is now better!
[*]I fixed some bugs and glitches!
[*]I corrected over 250 typos, which were overlooked by the former team!
[*]I did a lot of engine-related stuff. It was very complicated and would take too long to explain.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and for your continued support.
Your feedback is priceless to me!

Sincerly,
Martin Jeremiah Apple
Founder & CEO

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 (Splitscreen Update)
notes.content:
For this update we focused on the Splitscreen mode. We reworked some visuals and added more tracks, which you can play together on one keyboard or via Steam Remote Play.

[list]
[*]Added 5 new tracks for Splitscreen with different difficulties
[*]Reworked Splitscreen visuals
[*]Fixed minor bugs and glitches
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.9.0b
notes.content:
Here is a small update with the following fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed reset and lighting bugs in the later city levels
[*]Fixed a bug where the diary is stuck when you advance dialogue with your mouse
[*]Multiplayer motivational dialogues are now skippable
[*]Multiplayer playing fields are now numbered
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.0a
notes.content:
After taking in all your feedback, we made the following changes:

[list]
[*]Work-level: fixed a bug where an Input Field was not clickable
[*]Diary-level: thought-bubbles are now clickable only once
[*]Dance-level: now shows you which buttons you have to press
[*]General: fixed some titles and text boxes
[/list]
